headline: Woodside Energy to cut 500 jobs, plans 10% workforce reduction globally
summary: Woodside Energy plans to cut around 500 jobs globally, representing 10% of its workforce, as part of an expanded $400 million cost-cutting initiative. Under CEO Liz Westcott, the Australian energy firm is streamlining operations to achieve a unified 12% to 15% return-on-investment target across all projects. The restructuring aims to support a 32% production increase by 2032 despite ongoing portfolio reviews and asset divestments.

headline: Robert Armour takes on executive talent acquisition leadership at First Abu Dhabi Bank
summary: First Abu Dhabi Bank has appointed Robert Armour as its new Vice President and Head of Executive Talent Acquisition to lead executive hiring across the banking group. Armour brings 17 years of recruitment experience, having previously held talent acquisition leadership roles at KATIM and HSBC. His background encompasses technology hiring, agency recruitment, and in-house talent acquisition management across the UAE and London markets.

headline: herSTORY: Nandini Matiyani, GCHRO, Strides
summary: Nandini Matiyani, Group Chief Human Resources Officer at Strides, transitioned from sales and process improvement into HR, developing a commercially-minded approach to talent management. Inspired by an early career experience of leadership advocacy against gender pay disparity, she now actively sponsors high-potential female leaders and drives systemic workplace equity.

headline: SC freezes BMC chief’s salary over delay in clearing encroachments
summary: The Supreme Court of India has frozen the salary of Mumbai civic chief Ashwini Bhide and initiated contempt proceedings against the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) over unfulfilled orders to clear land encroachments. The court rejected the civic body's request for a 30-day extension to clear the Borivali plot designated for a bus station and imposed a Rs 5 lakh fine. The case underscores a growing judicial trend of holding senior public officials personally accountable for administrative delays.

headline: Why is Karnataka’s Local Jobs Bill on hold?
summary: The Karnataka government has paused its proposed local jobs reservation bill following pushback from industry groups concerned about hiring restrictions and investment impacts. Officials are currently reviewing the policy and analyzing legal challenges to similar laws in other states while emphasizing local skilling programs.

headline: Case-in-Point: The internal whistleblower bypass
summary: A sustainability analyst at NovaEnergy bypassed the company's internal whistleblower system to report overstated carbon offset disclosures directly to regulators. Although the voluntary correction helped NovaEnergy avoid formal regulatory penalties, the external reporting triggered media scrutiny and reputational strain. HR now faces a dilemma over whether to protect the employee for exposing a genuine compliance failure or address his decision to bypass established internal channels.
